environment.database_role: symphony_app for command/recovery paths; symphony schema owner for isolated fixture setup

commands.command: npm run test:db --workspace @symphony/db -- src/__tests__/command-reconciliation.integration.test.ts (9 tests; app role symphony_app)

claims.behavior_proved: A stale accepted command stores one terminal VERSION_CONFLICT receipt and one encrypted reconciliation item atomically, replays without rerunning the handler, and leaves aggregate state, events and outbox unchanged. Changed actor/envelope reuse is rejected. Lifecycle compare-and-set permits one terminal transition; expiry clears ciphertext and key reference while retaining a tombstone without replacing resolved/superseded status. Live TCP fault tests prove fresh-connection recovery after both a committed COMMIT whose response is lost and a COMMIT dropped before PostgreSQL receives it, with one logical command ID and no duplicate effects. Provider tests prove randomized ciphertext, a versioned SFE1 envelope marker, explicit not_for_production metadata, and fail-closed wrong-key/tamper/unsupported-version handling without plaintext in metadata or ciphertext.
claims.path_proved: Focused domain, PostgreSQL, migration, REM-WP1.2/REM-WP1.3 regression, full workspace typecheck, architecture, traceability and Phase 1 contract gates passed on the current working tree. REM-WP1.4 command/recovery integration ran against isolated symphony_phase1_test as restricted role symphony_app; fixture setup used symphony. The app-role test verified role attributes, actual least-privilege grants, forced RLS, denied DELETE, tenant isolation, pooled tenant-context reset, and both real TCP COMMIT-loss outcomes.
claims.configuration_proved: Node v26.7.0, npm 12.2.0, PostgreSQL 18.0-2 (server_version_num=180000), DATA_MODE=test, isolated symphony_phase1_test reached through the symphony credentials, and deterministic LocalDevKeyProvider test keys. The URL is stored only in ignored local .env.local; no credential is retained in evidence.
coverage_limitations: REM-WP3.6 standalone task evidence is now recorded at evidence/phase1/wp3.6/task-evidence.json; its local/test-only provider status is verified and no production-provider claim is made.
The initial red assertion was observed before production changes, but its raw command output was not retained; see red-test-record.md.
